status: audit complete; integration blocked pending findings

issues.title: Positive source release can leave the canonical source pool unchanged
issues.evidence: Actual Coupler::prepare with inventory {1e15,-0.01} emits weight 1.0000000000000024e-30 while both candidate inventory limbs remain identical to the accepted base. The same header is used by the reviewed root thermal port.
issues.consequence: Gas ExactParticleCount can retain that emitted weight, but cannot reconstruct the source debit already lost by the two-word update. Source plus gas count increases.
issues.remediation: Use one admitted exact represented-count transaction for source debit and gas credit, or explicitly reject an unrepresentable source debit with quantified unresolved scope. Reuse the existing sealed arithmetic where its contract fits; do not add a competing count backend.

issues.title: Packet allocation is not an exact partition of the source debit
issues.evidence: Actual preparation fully releases inventory 1 into 10 packets and passes assigned==released. The exact sum of returned binary64 weights is 36028797018963973/36028797018963968 = 1 + 5/2^55.
issues.consequence: Crediting those exact packet weights creates a 1.3877787807814457e-16 count excess even if source debit itself is exact. A rounded floating sum is not an exact conservation proof.
issues.remediation: Validate the exact sum of all actual positive packet parts against the exact source debit before any owner publishes. Reject an unsupported allocation/cap; never silently truncate or alter weights after accounting.

issues.classification: confirmed binding gap; planned integration blocker
issues.title: Public source proposals and mesh aliases are not sealed by metadata preflight
issues.evidence: Doubling Candidate.state.native.particle.weight leaves preflight true and import succeeds with the original path charge. Replacing PreparedPatch.native.spectrum by a 1600 K spectrum retains and accepts the old 1500 K exposure key. Reconstructing an identical Coupler at the same address lets its predecessor candidate pass. Mutating an external nonconst Mesh alias changes field gathering while matches_trial stays true.
issues.consequence: Field-array copies alone do not seal complete source payload, owner lifetime or geometry. Parent must not treat the binding-only preflight as a complete count/arena/source commit certificate.
issues.remediation: Keep prepared inputs/proposals under an opaque immutable owner, bind actual payload/geometry/field bits and canonical attributes, retain owner lifetime plus generation, and revalidate every owner at the final common barrier. API-v3 already assigns external count-owner truth to the parent; this is not evidence of an incorrect source kernel.

issues.title: Positive representable packet weight can silently lose all weighted charge and heat
issues.evidence: A 300 K thermal birth with weight approximately 1e-310 succeeds and preflights with positive physical_electron_number_change, particle_charge_change_C=-0 and wall_heat_J=-0. Its exact physical charge magnitude is approximately 1.602e-329 C.
issues.consequence: Positive binary64 weight alone is not a sufficient representability condition for scalar charge/energy ledgers. Exact gas count does not fix weighted charge/energy underflow.
issues.remediation: Retain the nonzero contributions with an explicit supported representation or reject the whole proposal with quantified unresolved count/charge/energy scope. Do not install a cold floor, change packet weight automatically or report the source as physically zero.

issues.classification: confirmed draft coordinator defect by source inspection
issues.title: Final joint preflight does not bind the mutable proposed field to native final seals
issues.evidence: Native motion/final seals capture field_after during preparation. AxialJointTrial.field remains public and mutable; final preflight checks accepted field/heat/census and heat ticket, but not the current proposed field hash, its actual midpoint arrays or its equality to the native final field seal. Publication swaps the current mutable field.
issues.consequence: An edit after native sealing can publish a field different from the field named by the accepted native boundary and checkpoint seals. This independently confirms the root-reported concern; no joint test was run.
issues.remediation: Make the final proposal opaque or retain/revalidate complete content seals at the common barrier, including actual midpoint equality and the native field/heat/source/RNG final seals.

issues.classification: documented scalar/log limitation; not an undisclosed v3 defect
issues.title: A zero expected-count scalar does not imply zero exposure
issues.evidence: At 300 K, area_fraction=1e-250 and dt=1e-14, the intermediate product underflows: scalar count=0 and current_underflow=false, yet log_expected_number=-714.51649451502885 and exp(log count)=4.8913552196320394e-311.
issues.remediation: The source count owner must consume the separate log exposure, handle both current and product underflow, and retain or explicitly reject finite-log positive scope. The current-underflow flag alone is insufficient.

issues.title: No qualified production emission-count/arrival/RNG policy
issues.evidence: V3 accepts caller-supplied weight, marks, IDs, count receipt and one of three explicit birth-time policies. It allocates no count/ID/RNG and owns no residual arrival clock. New sampler work is research/design only and paused.
issues.remediation: Root must explicitly choose and qualify packet statistics/weight, real arrival timing, persistent residual clock/RNG, common-random-base nonlinear reevaluation, cap rollback and exact accepted restart. Fixed-weight qualification fixtures are not a production count model.

issues.title: Reviewed canonical coordinator is resident-only and rejects source/boundary changes
issues.evidence: Native motion requires empty source/boundary receipts, identical resident membership/species/weights, and all_native_carriers_no_sources_no_boundaries. The closed coordinator declares surface_source_and_collection=false. It does not invoke source-v3.
issues.remediation: Add a separately reviewed canonical owner for births, persistent Active layers, handoff/recollection, boundary charge/energy, source/gas exact transfer and their common commit. Do not relabel this closed parent test as the requested thermal/field source integration.

issues.classification: unimplemented integration and physics scope decision
issues.title: Active-layer collision/remap ownership has no qualified composition
issues.evidence: Active source transport evolves a copied LayerState with fixed source weight/species and microscopic image ownership. Ordinary motion exclusion is required, but no collision or count-remap adapter updates the auxiliary state.
issues.remediation: Keep exactly one canonical particle per layer, include it and prospective births in global guards, and define collision exposure over its actual life. Either preserve an explicitly bounded collisionless Active-layer model or implement and qualify conservative collision/remap/reaction updates to both canonical and layer states. Never silently overwrite a collision result from stale auxiliary momentum.

issues.title: Component replay does not prove an atomic all-owner source restart
issues.evidence: V3 qualifies typed layer/heat payloads and identical next current/charge/heat under reconstructed fields. It has no common checkpoint coordinator or arrival-clock owner. BoundLayerState does not contain the external canonical-ID map or sampler policy/RNG/residual clock.
issues.remediation: Atomically checkpoint accepted arena/counts, layer-to-canonical-ID mapping, heat/inventories/watermarks, field, geometry/slice/model/species seals, source count/residual/RNG/ID state and clock. Verify complete next proposals and rejected retries across restart; reject mixed snapshots and rebuild unaccepted tokens.

issues.classification: unsupported physics outside explicit conditional model
issues.title: Source/material flags do not establish experimental or full plasma applicability
issues.evidence: The source is a locally planar equilibrium free-electron, stationary unmagnetized barrier model with explicit magnetic/image/geometry guards and conditional unit accommodation. Work function 4.3 eV is a clean-surface benchmark, not a measured dynamic SS304/oxide/water surface. V3 admission flags are caller assertions.
issues.remediation: Document supported surface/phase/work-function, local field-valid region, quantum magnetic and quasi-steady limits, return accommodation and omitted surface physics. Reject unsupported samples without guard-driven resampling. Do not infer a physical screening/breakdown history from component closure.

issues.title: Accepted temperature and immutable midpoint fields are distinct, deliberate stages
issues.evidence: Source-v3 honestly uses accepted T and actual trial midpoint E/B. This is a held-temperature source treatment, not a jointly implicit midpoint-temperature solve; the component has no global source/field/chemistry convergence result.
issues.remediation: Retain thermal and strong-field supply at both electrodes with signed local total fields, partition area once, and establish temporal/spatial/packet-weight/nonlinear convergence for the coupled source/field/heat model. Keep source-law/field mesh and physical/collision domain limitations explicit.
